tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends a new email. Supports plain text, HTML, multipart/alternative, CC/BCC, reply threading, and file attachments via local file paths.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Draft a new email without sending it. Supports the same fields as send_email, including attachments.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Retrieves the content of a specific email by message ID, including headers, body (plain/HTML), and attachment metadata (filename, type, size, download ID).

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Searches for emails using Gmail search syntax (e.g. from:sender@example.com, in:inbox, has:attachment, after:2024/01/01).

tools.name: modify_email
tools.description: Modifies email labels — add or remove labels to move emails between folders, archive, mark read/unread, etc.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Permanently deletes an email by message ID.

tools.name: list_email_labels
tools.description: Retrieves all available Gmail labels (system and user-defined).

tools.name: batch_modify_emails
tools.description: Modifies labels for multiple emails in efficient batches (default batch size 50).

tools.name: batch_delete_emails
tools.description: Permanently deletes multiple emails in efficient batches (default batch size 50).

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Creates a new Gmail label with optional message-list and label-list visibility settings.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Updates an existing Gmail label (rename or change visibility settings).

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Deletes a Gmail label by label ID.

tools.name: get_or_create_label
tools.description: Gets an existing label by name or creates it if it doesn't exist.

tools.name: create_filter
tools.description: Creates a new Gmail filter with custom criteria (from, to, subject, query, attachments, size) and actions (add/remove labels, forward).

tools.name: get_filter
tools.description: Gets details of a specific Gmail filter by filter ID.

tools.name: delete_filter
tools.description: Deletes a Gmail filter by filter ID.

tools.name: create_filter_from_template
tools.description: Creates a filter using a pre-defined template: fromSender, withSubject, withAttachments, largeEmails, containingText, or mailingList.

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Downloads an email attachment to a local directory. Requires messageId and attachmentId from read_email output.
